caption: The drawing depicts a single brass candlestick holder positioned upright and centrally on a plain, light beige background. The candlestick is cylindrical with a flared top, a slightly wider midsection, and a substantial round base. It has a small, knob-like protrusion on its central stem. The color of the candlestick is a gradient of golden yellows and browns, suggesting metallic highlights and shadows, and the base also exhibits reflections typical of a polished brass surface. The entire composition is framed by a thin drawn border near the edge of the paper, and the artist’s name, "JANET RIZA," is inscribed in the bottom right corner.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
